question: What are the different ways to set an environment variable value in a Kubernetes Container according to the API schema?

ground_truth.answer: EnvVar defines a single environment variable for a Container. The name field (required) is the variable name. A value can be supplied in two mutually exclusive ways: value is a plain string literal (supports $(VAR_NAME) substitution); valueFrom is an EnvVarSource referencing an external source: fieldRef (ObjectFieldSelector — downward API: Pod metadata, spec.nodeName, status.podIP); resourceFieldRef (ResourceFieldSelector — container resource requests/limits); configMapKeyRef (ConfigMapKeySelector — reads a key from a ConfigMap); secretKeyRef (SecretKeySelector — reads a key from a Secret). If both value and valueFrom are absent the variable is set to an empty string.
context: io.k8s.api.core.v1.EnvVar: name (required) and value (string) or valueFrom (EnvVarSource) define a single environment variable for a Container
io.k8s.api.core.v1.EnvVarSource: fieldRef, resourceFieldRef, configMapKeyRef, and secretKeyRef are the four mutually exclusive source types
io.k8s.api.core.v1.ConfigMapKeySelector: selects a key from a ConfigMap by name and key
io.k8s.api.core.v1.SecretKeySelector: selects a key from a Secret by name and key
